sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B: Liquid AI's On-Device Agent Model Runs at 220 Tokens/s in ...
sources.snippet: On August 4, 2026, Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B, an open-weight model whose pitch is simple: an agent that fits in 2.5 GB of memory, runs on a laptop CPU, and beats models four times its size on instruction following and tool use. The company measured 220 tokens/s decoding on an Apple M5 Max, 113 tokens/s on an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, and around 30 tokens/s on a phone, all under 2.5 GB of ...

sources.title: oamazonasgabriel/lfm2.5-2.6b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B by Liquid AI — deploy agents everywhere. A 2.6B dense reasoning model (Q4_K_M, ~1.7 GB) with native tool calling, 128K context, and 16-language support. Runs on any 8 GB GPU.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B: Deploy Agents Everywhere | Blog | Liquid AI
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is an on-device agentic model that plans, calls tools, and runs multi-step tasks at 220 tok/s in under 2.5 GB. Open weights on Hugging Face.
